youtube.title: WEDNESDAY WEBINAR
youtube.summary: Former Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash joins Maree Buscke for a wide-ranging webinar on strategic voting under MMP, explaining why National's electorate strength could waste its party vote and urging centre-right voters to split their ballots. They cover ballooning government debt, the case for raising the super age, Treaty of Waitangi politics, GST's regressive edge, and why bold fiscal reform has been politically unpalatable since Ruth Richardson. For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday. For links mentioned in the webinar: RCR CONTENT: Don Brash | Strategic Voting, MMP Overhang & the 2026 Election A Political Agenda with Maree Buscke, Sandra Goudie & Joshua Riley | Are NZ’s Laws Putting Rights & Freedoms at Risk? A Political Agenda with Maree Buscke, Ro Edge and David Lynch | Political Accountability, MMP & the Rise of TOP A Politcal Agenda with Maree Buscke, Rachel Stewart and Rob MacCulloch | Political Messaging vs Meaningful Policy OTHER MEDIA: Birthgap | Documentary on the worldwide birth rate

youtube.title: IVOR CUMMINS
youtube.summary: Ivor Cummins joins Paul Brennan from Dublin to recount his close encounter with Trump during the president's recent Irish visit, before turning to demographic data suggesting native Irish could become a minority within decades. They also dissect the backlash over a controversial male lactation conference and debate whether under-16 social media age verification is really about protecting children or ending online anonymity. Discover more from Ivor on his website The Fat Emperor or find him on Facebook and X For news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday.

youtube.title: LAURA MCCLURE
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke speaks with ACT Party List MP Laura McClure about ACT’s new six-point small-business package, including a proposed youth training wage, freezing the minimum wage for three years, union fees and employment rules. They also discuss tax treatment for new technology, immigration settings, supermarket competition, the cost of essentials and ACT’s newly announced list, including Paul Henry’s entry into politics. For more on Laura McClure or find her on Facebook For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday.

youtube.title: MEDIA MATTERS
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke and Marty Gibson debate the media storm around AI existential risk, sparked by a young ex-Anthropic employee's public warnings and contrasting political reactions from Trump and Christopher Luxon. Maree argues fear over AI safety is being manufactured to entrench a handful of tech giants through capturing regulation, while Marty counters that the danger is real and society lacks the structures to debate it honestly, closing on his case for smaller, human-scale communities as a buffer against technocratic control. For more information check out Reclaim the Net | How the AI safety push creates new gatekeepers For news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday.

youtube.title: MAREE’S MUSINGS
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke examines the disciplinary censure of Nelson GP Dr Caroline Wheeler over her off-label prescribing of ivermectin during Covid, arguing the case's real significance lies beyond the drug itself. For news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday.

What will the next election really look like? And could strategic voting change everything?

youtube.title: CRAIG STOBO
youtube.summary: Tane Webster talks with Craig Stobo, NZ First's Botany candidate, about his path from diplomacy and funds management to frontline politics. He recounts his time at the 2022 Parliament protest, explains his economic nationalism stance on the Paris Accord and outlines plans for a $100 billion sovereign wealth fund modelled on Norway, alongside his views on lifting wages, fixing education and easing the cost of living. Discover more on Craig Stobo

youtube.title: MONEY TALKS
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan and Simon Angelo examine the turbulence in global bond markets, November’s election and concerns over property rights, taxation and capital flight. They then explore whether AI will destroy jobs or reshape employment, before turning to the limits of universal basic income and the importance of family, purpose and meaningful relationships. DISCLAIMER: The views and information shared on this show are for educational and informational purposes only. They do not constitute personalised financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Listeners should seek guidance from a licensed financial professional who can provide advice based on their individual situation. Discover more from Simon at Wealth Morning

youtube.title: ANDREW DOYLE
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke sits down with British writer and comedian Andrew Doyle, touring New Zealand with the Free Speech Union, to discuss the erosion of free expression in the UK and warning signs closer to home. They cover ideological capture in policing, academia and the BBC, the Jason Arday controversy at Cambridge, why comedians have become free speech's front line and Andrew's measured take on the genuine risks posed by superintelligent AI. Discover more from Andrew Doyle on his website and X
